suggestions.description: Use f-string and logging module instead of print for better production readiness
suggestions.after:
import logging

logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO)
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

def main():
    feature_name = "New feature"
    logger.info(f"{feature_name} added!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
suggestions.benefits: Enables log level control, output redirection, and structured logging. F-strings provide better readability and performance. Production applications should use logging over print.

suggestions.description: Add type hints and configuration pattern for message customization
suggestions.after:
from typing import Final

FEATURE_MESSAGE: Final[str] = "New feature added!"

def display_message(message: str = FEATURE_MESSAGE) -> None:
    """Display a feature message.
    
    Args:
        message: The message to display (default: FEATURE_MESSAGE)
    """
    print(message)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    display_message()
suggestions.benefits: Type hints improve IDE support and catch type errors. Constants make the message configurable and testable. The Final hint prevents reassignment.
